one_liner: Freshdesk has a broad REST v2 API authenticated with per-agent API keys (Basic key:X). API access appears to need a trial or paid plan, and the vendor now runs an official remote MCP server at https://<subdomain>.freshdesk.com/mcp.
auth_notes: The supplied pages confirm API-key auth for the vendor MCP server. They don't show the REST Basic-auth mechanism (key as username, "X" as password) in the retrieved text, so that part comes from the draft and from general knowledge of Freshdesk. No OAuth 2.0 flow for the public API appears in the pages. The Composio catalog lists API_KEY only.
access_notes: The API page says trial users get a default limit of 50 calls/minute, so the API works in a trial. The page lists API rate limits only for paid plans (Growth, Pro, Enterprise and the older plans). The pages don't state whether the Free or Sprout plan has API access, so the draft's no-free-path claim is unverified here. The vendor MCP server is listed only for Growth, Pro and Enterprise.
blocker_notes: Development needs a trial (50 calls/min) or a paid plan. Rate limits are account-wide. Each customer must supply their own subdomain and API key. The MCP server is available only on Growth, Pro and Enterprise, with per-plan action allowances.
